prompts.frost-scarab: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production 2D pixel-art fantasy RPG MONSTER animation sprite sheet on genuine transparent background. Exactly FOUR equal columns by SIX equal rows, 24 full-body animation frames. Portrait canvas. No text, no grid, no scenery, no floor shadows. All frames show the SAME creature with consistent proportions, identity, scale, facing LEFT, centered within each equal rectangular cell, fixed feet baseline, generous padding. Never cross cell boundaries. Charming detailed clean pixel-art matching a Thai Lanna fantasy dungeon RPG, readable at 100px tall. Distinct action poses, anatomically consistent. Subject: A squat six-legged ice scarab beetle, huge faceted blue crystal carapace, icy mandibles, short legs, no humanoid features. Attacks with snapping mandibles.
